topic: What happens if you stop exercising?
title: What quitting exercise does
hook: What happens if you stop exercising?

beats.label: 2 WEEKS
beats.line: After two weeks off, your stamina can already start to slip.

beats.label: 3 WEEKS
beats.line: By week three, your heart beats faster for the same workout.

beats.label: 1 MONTH
beats.line: After a month, the muscle you built can start to shrink.

beats.label: 2 MONTHS
beats.line: By two months, your blood pressure can creep back up.

beats.label: 3 MONTHS
beats.line: Three months in, much of your hard-won fitness can be gone.

end.line: So, when did you last break a sweat?

description: Week by week: how your stamina, heart, muscles and blood pressure change when you stop working out.

facts.claim: Aerobic fitness (VO2max) can decline measurably within about 2 to 4 weeks of stopping training.
After 2 to 3 weeks of detraining, blood volume and stroke volume fall, so heart rate is higher at the same workload.
facts.source: Coyle et al., J Appl Physiol 1984 / 1986

facts.claim: Muscle size gained through training starts to decline within weeks of stopping training.
Exercise lowers blood pressure, but the benefit lasts only as long as you keep exercising.
After about 2 to 3 months without training, much of the aerobic fitness gained can be lost.
facts.source: Coyle et al., J Appl Physiol 1984
